name: context-handoff
description: Secure context handoff between Agent sessions: Go zero-knowledge relay + Node client/skill with client-side AES-256-GCM.

scripts.build:server: cd server-go && GO111MODULE=on CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o handoff-server .
scripts.check: node --check client/cli.js && node --check client/crypto.js && node --check client/handoff.js && cd server-go && gofmt -l . && GO111MODULE=on go vet ./...
